### `class VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/mixin/VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin.java`
Copies the talking-state flag into VillagerRenderState's own per-frame snapshot via Fabric API's render-state side channel (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-003, ARCH-DEC-004: never a custom EntityRenderState subclass) — confirmed the correct 26.2 mechanism by direct source read of fabric-rendering-v1's own RenderStateMixin (mixed into EntityRenderState itself, so every subclass, VillagerRenderState included, already implements FabricRenderState; research §D4's own worked example, PigRendererMixin, is the identical pattern for a different entity).

### `class ZombieVillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/compat/mixin/ZombieVillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin.java`
VillagerTalkingRenderStateMixin's own twin for a zombified villager — docs/spec/ 04-architecture.md's loader-adapter table names both VillagerRenderer and ZombieVillagerRenderer explicitly, since a talking villager can be zombified mid-session and ClientTalkingState is keyed by the entity's own java.util.UUID, unaffected by that transformation.
